test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 31 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
The cost of two bus tickets from city P to Q and three bus tickets from city P to R is ₹ 99, but the cost of three bus tickets from city P to Q and two bus tickets from city P to R is ₹ 91.

Then what is the fare from city P to Q and city P to R respectively?
solution:
**Given:**

The cost of two bus tickets from city P to Q and three bus tickets from city P to R is ₹99.

The cost of three bus tickets from city P to Q and two bus tickets from city P to R is ₹91.

**Formula used:**

Let the fare from city P to Q be ₹x and the fare from city P to R be ₹y.

2x + 3y = 99

3x + 2y = 91

**Calculations:**

2x + 3y = 99 ... (i)
